title: A new session starts from the task the handoff names, and only from that task
summary: The /newtask flow is written down as four fixed steps: read the root HANDOFF.md, open the context ledger with `npm run budget -- --reset --task <id>`, pick one and only one task file out of docs/tasks/*.json, and work on that task's assertions alone. The id comes from the single machine readable `Task: <id>` line of the handoff and from nowhere else — a missing, ambiguous or unknown id is a hard error, there is no fallback and no automatic pick. The failures of the other task files may be reported but must never be fixed on the side.

assertions.text: the handoff must carry the marked block
the handoff must name exactly one task
the task of a new session has to be unique
the task of a new session has to be unique and inside the block
